facts.claim: Manav Rao, a partner at Lumen Ventures, wrote on the eighth of August that it was good to meet Meera the week before.
facts.quote: Meera Iyer would send a one-pager. Thanks, Manav Rao Partner, Lumen Ventures

facts.claim: He asked for Kitebird's current traction — clinics live, revenue run-rate and the pilot pipeline — before Lumen's Monday partners' meeting, and told his partners she would send a one-pager.
facts.quote: current traction metrics - clinics live, revenue run-rate and the pilot pipeline? I told

facts.claim: The ask is open and waits on us, and the file names the move as ours.
The engine filed the ask as an admin situation, though the file's kind of work is investor.
The file's playbook is for running an investor conversation to a decision, and it is not yet reviewed.

inferences.claim: The first meeting is behind them and Lumen is taking Kitebird to its partners: the conversation has moved past a first call.
Manav has vouched for the one-pager in front of his partners; if it misses Monday, he goes into the room without it.
The numbers he asked for are not in the file, so the one-pager is the founder's to write.

patterns.claim: When the turn is ours with an investor, the clock runs against us and nobody says so; a late or partial answer reads as lost momentum. A prior, not yet reviewed.
About half the companies reviewed at a partners' meeting go on to diligence, and silence more than a week after the meeting usually means no. A prior, not measured here.
A warm partner is not a commitment: only a definite offer in writing counts, however well the meeting went. A prior, not yet reviewed.
A round's momentum comes from investors seeing others move, so Lumen's partners' meeting counts for more if the rest of the round is moving too. A prior, not yet reviewed.

hypotheses.proposition: Kitebird is on the agenda of Lumen's Monday partners' meeting.
hypotheses.needs: Manav's word — his mail implies it without saying so outright.

hypotheses.proposition: A one-pager with these numbers already exists from the founder's other investor conversations.
hypotheses.needs: The founder's word; the file holds no such document.

unknowns.question: The current numbers themselves: clinics live, revenue run-rate and the pilot pipeline.
unknowns.relevance: They are not in the file, so the one-pager can only come from the founder.

unknowns.question: When on Monday the partners meet.
unknowns.relevance: If they meet early, the one-pager has to reach Manav before the weekend is out.

unknowns.question: What else Manav needs to carry Kitebird into the room — a deck, a memo, a call before the meeting.
unknowns.relevance: A partner who presents a company to the partnership often needs the story as well as the numbers.

frames.primary: An investor carrying you into his partners' meeting: Manav needs the traction one-pager before Monday, he has told his partners it is coming, and the move is ours.
rivals: A routine information request from a fund still taking a first look, where Monday's meeting is the firm's weekly slot rather than a decision on Kitebird.
Diligence starting early, where the one-pager is the first of several requests for material.

expected_vs_actual.expected: At the partner meeting stage the playbook expects the partner who brought the company in to carry it to the firm's weekly meeting with what the partners need; the firm then opens diligence, makes an offer or passes, usually within one weekly cycle.
expected_vs_actual.actual: The first meeting took place the week before; Manav has asked for traction numbers before Monday's partners' meeting and promised his partners a one-pager. Nothing has gone back yet.

scenarios.do_nothing: Manav goes into Monday's meeting without the one-pager he promised his partners; at best you slip a week, at worst you read as a company losing momentum and the fund quietly drops.
scenarios.act: The one-pager reaches Manav before Monday, he carries real numbers into the room, and the partnership can decide on Kitebird in this cycle.
scenarios.best: After Monday the partners ask for diligence material or a meeting with the founder.
scenarios.worst: The one-pager arrives late or thin, the partners pass, and the pass arrives as silence.
signals_to_watch: Manav confirming he has the one-pager before the meeting.
A request for diligence material or a partner meeting after Monday.
Silence more than a week after the partners' meeting.

reasons: Raising the seed round is the brief's first goal, and the brief lists Lumen Ventures as engaged.
The partners meet on Monday and Manav has promised them the one-pager.
A partners' meeting met with nothing in hand cannot be rerun on demand; the next chance is a later cycle, at the firm's pleasure.

next_move.what: Reply to Manav with a one-page summary of current traction — clinics live, revenue run-rate and the pilot pipeline — before Lumen's Monday partners' meeting, and offer to answer the partners' questions.
next_move.for_whom: Manav Rao and the Lumen Ventures partners

parsed.alternative: If the one-pager cannot be ready in time, reply now with the numbers he asked for in the body of the mail, and the one-pager to follow.
parsed.wait_or_stop: Do not wait: the partners meet on Monday. After the meeting, give Lumen its weekly cycle; if a week passes with no word, ask Manav directly what the partners decided.
parsed.done_when: Manav has the one-pager before the partners' meeting and confirms it reached them.
parsed.draft: Hi Manav, good to meet you too. Ahead of Monday's partners' meeting, here is our one-pager with Kitebird's current traction: clinics live, revenue run-rate and the pilot pipeline. Happy to answer any questions the partners have, before or after the meeting. Best, Meera
